notes:
CRM notes (shorthand):
- Background: Tidecrest Engage builds an in-app customer support assistant for SMB ecommerce merchants. Lightweight UI, multi-turn chat + nightly summarization jobs. Mostly public cloud, self-serve signups.
- Current pain: Latency variability for EU users since 2/24 campaign. Report: avg latency (us-east) ~380ms, p95 ~550ms; europe p95 observed ~1.1s-1.3s during spikes. User complaints: 'chat laggy on peak' + some timeouts in mobile clients.
- What they tried: pinned model = "small-conversational-v1" (hosted_api), default timeouts in client (10s), no streaming enabled, full transcript included in each prompt (~3k tokens).
- SE note (Ravi): root cause likely cross-region hops + large prompt payloads + no streaming; also client-side timeout too aggressive for occasional cold starts. Request logs show repeated identical system prompt across turns (opportunity for prefix caching).
- Quick wins recommended (shared on call):
  * Move EU traffic -> nearest region (eu-west-1) via routing policy in Console (steps + sample config sent).
  * Enable streaming responses in SDK to improve perceived latency on mobile.
  * Increase client timeout to 30s for initial rollout; track actual tail latency and lower later.
  * Trim prompt context: keep rolling convo window to ~1.5k tokens not 3k; store long history server-side and fetch only last N turns.
  * Use prefix/KV cache for static system prompt and knowledge snippets (reduces token work per request).
  * Consider a smaller-latency model variant for high-throughput interactive paths (we suggested redwood-lite-1 as fallback) and use routing/fallback policies for cost/latency tradeoffs.
  * Add token budgeting: lower max_tokens for chat reply when user query simple (heuristic-based).
- Performance expectations: with eu region + streaming + prompt trimming we expect p95 -> ~400-600ms for typical interactive queries; worst-case large-gen still up to 1.5s depending on model.
- Security/compliance: customer requires SOC2 attestation before signing; asked for audit logging details + retention policy. Sent security FAQ link (drive).
- Quotes / customer color: "If we can get EU latency consistent under ~700ms we'll greenlight paid tier" — Head of Product.
- Next steps ownering: Maya to send tailored perf playbook and sample routing config; Ravi to host 30m walkthrough (region routing + timeout + streaming) w/ eng lead. Wish list: SOC2 report, simple pricing example for 50k interactions/mo.
- Open items: confirm expected ARR band for procurement, legal review timeline for SOC2, test EU region routing in staging, confirm whether they'll adopt streaming SDK now or later.
- Related artifacts: Fireflies ff-20260304-72a8 (call transcript), pricing deck in Drive, ticket RDW-1194 (profiling).
notes_summary: SMB self-serve lead with EU latency complaints. Short-term fixes: route EU traffic to eu region, enable streaming, increase client timeout to 30s, trim prompt length and implement prefix caching. SOC2 required before purchase. 30m SE walkthrough scheduled as next touch.
